subject: Luminary Labs — request for combined trial boost + promotional credit approval
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@luminarylabs.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Luminary Labs — initial proposal for onboarding uplift

Hi Lucy,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Luminary team’s use cases for fine-grained retrieval + summarization map cleanly to our dedicated runtime. Based on the usage pattern you showed (30–50k tokens/day with several long-context searches), I put together a short onramp offer to remove friction for the pilot and accelerate time-to-value: 

- Three-month trial (instead of standard 30 days)
- $25,000 in platform credits applied to usage during the trial
- 20% first-year seats/consumption discount if you convert within 90 days

This package is promotional and requires an exec-level exception to our standard promo caps. I’ve attached the proposed onramp package (Luminary_Onramp_Package_v3.pdf) with the eligibility language and suggested milestone-based usage credits.

Would you be comfortable if we loop in our procurement and try to get a signature this week? If so I’ll route the ask internally for approval and push the DocuSign.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0194

---
Attachment: Luminary_Onramp_Package_v3.pdf (proposal, 6 pages)
From: Lucy Chen <lucy@luminarylabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Luminary Labs — initial proposal for onboarding uplift

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear proposal. The extended trial + credits would let us validate vector search across multiple product teams. A couple of practical questions from procurement: 

1) Can the credits be used across both hosted and dedicated workloads? We’ll likely start on hosted.
2) Are the credits refundable/transferable if we don’t use them within the 3 months?

Procurement (procurement@luminarylabs.com) is cc’d — they asked for a one-page term sheet for internal approval. If you can route the executive approval, we’ll prioritize review and get back with a signature.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Chen | Head of Product
Luminary Labs
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: Lucy Chen <lucy@luminarylabs.com>, procurement@luminarylabs.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Luminary Labs — combined trial extension + credits 

Marissa / Aditya —

Requesting exec approval for a combined concession to close Luminary Labs (deal DL-2026-0847). Summary: 

- Offer: 3-month trial (standard is 30 days) + $25k platform credit applied to usage; 20% first-year discount on committed consumption if converted within 90 days. 
- Business rationale: High strategic fit (multi-product use case), strong likelihood to convert given product roadmap alignment, and competitive tension (two other vendors in procurement).
- Financials: Expected ARR on conversion ~$150k; maximum one-time credit cost (to Redwood) estimated at $25k consumption during trial + marginal support costs.
- Risk mitigation: Credits expire at trial end, unused credits do not roll forward; credits only apply to hosted tier (we will permit credits to be used on hosted only; dedicated onboarding billable after conversion).

Attachments: I’ve attached the one-page term sheet and a redline with the credit expiry language (approved_term_sheet_redline.docx). Luminary is ready to sign the DocuSign once we get an internal green light.

Asks: 
- Aditya: final approval to offer combined promo above (approver for exceptions > $20k).
- Marissa: confirm CS can commit to the onboarding SLA for a 3-month pilot.

If it helps, I can turn the proposal into an internal summary slide for the sales committee.

Thanks,
Jasmine

---
Attachment: approved_term_sheet_redline.docx (term sheet redline)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 18:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Luminary Labs — combined trial extension + credits 

Jasmine —

Thanks for the concise summary. I reviewed the financials and the redline. Approve the package with one change: limit the 20% first-year discount to the first $100k of committed spend (protects us against outsized discounts). Keep the $25k credit and the 3-month trial as proposed.

Marissa — please confirm CS can support the pilot SLA and confirm the onboarding plan with the Solutions team. If CS is good, I’ll sign off and we can send the DocuSign.

Aditya Rao
VP, Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: Lucy Chen <lucy@luminarylabs.com>, procurement@luminarylabs.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Luminary Labs — combined trial extension + credits 

All —

CS confirms we can deliver the proposed onboarding SLA for a 3-month pilot. Solutions will provide a dedicated onboarding manager and two weekly checkpoints for the first 8 weeks. We’ll also include a health-check report at week 6 to determine readiness for conversion.

Jasmine — please update the term sheet to include Aditya’s cap on the 20% discount (first $100k) and the credit usage restriction (hosted only). Once updated, route to me and I’ll attach the DocuSign envelope and ping legal for a quick check.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
